page.overview:
Who is Reks?

Reks is a temporary playable character in the prologue to Final Fantasy XII who acts as tutorial for the player. As such, he is not easily killed and the player cannot change his equipment. He has Cure, Thunder and some healing potions, and is equipped with Mythril Sword, Buckler, Leather Cap and Leather Armor.

Reks starts at level 3. His levels and inventory are not transferred to Vaan, who starts at level 1, unlike later in the game where Vaan's level determines the levels of the allies that join the party later. Considering his stat development, Reks is the second fastest playable character after Reddas. However, it will be nigh impossible to level him up even once, as only the starter area Imperial Swordsmen give any EXP, and only if Reks deals the finishing blow over the knight NPCs that accompany him.

He cannot access the License Board and has no Quickening.
